items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: we, he sent Charlie Love in his place... tried to hold the country club down. We had, they were so crazy about our band out there

ctx.x: Did that Lions Club the one way uptown, where they had the carnival parades?

Did they have that, no, that's a white, they had the Lions Club downtown, too. Well, is that colored down? Yeah, colored, yeah, they had colored down. That's what he played for? Yeah. I didn't know about that. Where else was that? That, uh, it was, uh, it was, uh, it was some way down on Liberty Street, uh, where the friends on me, you heard about the fronds on me, all around there. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Some way down in that part of the section. New St. Bernard circle, man. Yeah, yeah. And, uh, all them, practically…
No, I never heard of him. They haven't heard the name. Oh, he's a millionaire, yeah.
